channel.title: Jaylen Sinegal Blog
channel.description: Brand strategy, sports and entertainment, student-athletes, and Louisiana storytelling from Jaylen Sinegal.

item.title: Escaping Platform Lock-In: What Hudl's Terms Mean for Student-Athlete IP
item.description: Student-athletes upload highlight film to Hudl every day without reading the terms. Here is what those terms actually allow, where the lock-in lives, and how families can protect their own IP.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: How to Get Started as a College Student-Athlete: A Step-by-Step Scholarship and Recruiting Checklist
item.description: The ten-step operating system: pick your path, register with the NCAA Eligibility Center, build your academic and athletic file, build your college list, contact coaches, search for money separately, complete FAFSA and TOPS, and track everything.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: The Scholarship Is Not the Strategy: A Louisiana Student-Athlete's Guide to Finding College Opportunities
item.description: Understanding D1, D2, D3 and JUCO opportunities, NCAA eligibility, Louisiana resources like TOPS and FAFSA, and why a complete athletic profile matters more than a highlight reel.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: HBCU College Athletics in Louisiana: Recruiting, Scholarships, and the SWAC Advantage
item.description: Why an HBCU can be a strategy, not a fallback: Grambling, Southern, Dillard, Xavier, and SUNO, the athletic money that exists, the aid stack on top of TOPS and FAFSA, the honest NIL picture, and how recruiting works in the SWAC.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: Ragin FC Is More Than a Fight Night. It's a Louisiana Sports Brand.
item.description: A strategic perspective on Ragin Fighting Championship: building fighter stories, gym rivalries, community audiences, sponsor value, and content before, during, and after the event.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: I Don't Just Plan Events. I Build the System Behind Them.
item.description: What building events taught me about brand strategy, operations, sponsorship, marketing, music licensing, copyright, and creating experiences that actually matter.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: Being Seen Isn't the Same as Being Remembered
item.description: How entrepreneurs and established businesses can build the memory structures that make a brand easier to recognize, trust, and choose.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: Trump's New Executive Order on College Sports and NIL
item.description: What the executive order means for athletes, families, schools, brands, and the future of personal branding.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: Who Is Jaylen Sinegal? Part One
item.description: Before the degrees, businesses, and professional titles, Jaylen Sinegal was a Lafayette child learning to adapt through 11 schools, family changes, sports, faith, loss, and new perspectives on leadership and identity.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal

item.title: Should Families Brand Their Kids Early? Hell Yes.
item.description: NIL isn't just for star athletes. Here's the research on goals, failure, and character, and why every kid can start building a brand before college.
item.author: Jaylen Sinegal
